text:
Current Projects
I am currently curious about how AI can help make teaching more accessible and inclusive. One goal is to create different AI-dubbed of the same lecture. The two videos below show an example from a Science Slam I held. The version on the left is the original German version, while the version on the right is an English dub created with ElevenLabs AI. The videos are available on YouTube.
